assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D game sprite atlas for BroBattler. Image 1 is the approved character identity and rendering reference; preserve its face, anatomy, outfit, materials and distinctive equipment, do not redesign. Draw TEN distinct animation poses of this SAME character in an exact regular grid of FIVE equal square cells across and TWO equal square cells down. Landscape canvas 2560x1024 (aspect 2.5:1). Top row faces south (three-quarter front toward viewer); bottom row faces north (three-quarter rear, back toward viewer), consistent game camera slightly elevated. In EACH row, left-to-right: idle, walking left step, walking right step, attack action, fallen dead on ground. Every cell contains ONE complete full-body figure and all its equipment, separated by generous blank margins; no pose overlaps cell borders. Standing frames identical character scale and camera, feet near same baseline at 90% cell height, similar center of mass; dead figure is horizontal and on same ground baseline, NEVER enlarged to fill vertical space. Hand-painted dark-fantasy realistic sprite style matching the reference, strong readable silhouettes at small game scale, detailed but crisp edges. No scenery, terrain, floor, cast shadows, perspective grid, text, labels, dividers, borders, outlines, UI or watermark. True transparent background preferred; if alpha output is unavailable use absolutely uniform solid vivid magenta #FF00FF, NOT a checkerboard, no gradients. Important: left and right walk frames MUST show opposite leg positions, not duplicated idle images.
Subject and actions: Same wiry elderly female alchemist, unruly grey ponytail, brass goggles, teal coat and ochre apron, green-acid flask and copper backpack apparatus. Walking: visibly alternate left and right boots, balanced purposeful strides, flask held close. Attack: throwing/pouring green corrosive flask forward with planted foot. Fallen: curled on side with backpack and intact flask beside her, no gore.
